assignmentTitle: Identification and Selection of Couplings Used in Mechanical Power Transmission

criteria.title: Component Identification
criteria.description: Accurate identification of motor, driving shaft, coupling hubs, flexible element, keys, bearings, driven shaft, and pump on EA-09.

criteria.title: Working Principle & Mechanics
criteria.description: Understanding torque transmission path and elastomeric flexible element shock/vibration damping mechanics.

criteria.title: Classification of Couplings
criteria.description: Correct classification of Rigid (Sleeve, Clamp, Flange) vs Flexible (Bushed-pin, Oldham, Gear, Elastomeric) coupling types.

criteria.title: Application Analysis
criteria.description: Identification of critical power transmission requirements for Motor-Pump, Compressor, Conveyor, and Machine Tool drives.

criteria.title: Coupling Comparison
criteria.description: Comparative analysis across rigidity, misalignment accommodation, shock damping, maintenance ease, and cost.

criteria.title: Engineering Requirements & Calculation
criteria.description: Accurate computation of transmitted nominal torque T = 145,892 N-mm and design torque Td = 218,838 N-mm.

criteria.title: Coupling Selection
criteria.description: Correct engineering selection of Bushed-Pin Flexible Coupling for the 22 kW motor-pump system.

criteria.title: Engineering Justification
criteria.description: Multi-faceted technical justification covering torque, misalignment, shock absorption, maintenance, and practicality.

criteria.title: Engineering Decision & Alternative Analysis
criteria.description: Structured decision matrix and technical evaluation of alternative couplings (e.g. Rigid Flange rejection).
